select suitable wire/flux combination and re-dry it at the suitable temperature as per manufacturers guidelines

• set the SAW machine and its parameters as per the WPS and SOP • Welding parameters and mechanisms: electrical parameters (type, amperage, voltage); welding speed; flux dispensing and recovery mechanisms; safety devices; wire feed rate; electrode stick-out; single pass or multi-pass; mechanical functions (handling, loading, work holding, transfer mode etc.
ensure that welding material surface is appropriately prepared with required heat treatment methods
verify set up by running test welds specimen
follow safety precautions during welding work as per SOP and organizational guidelines
fill the flux in the hopper and direct the nozzle or gravity feed over weld line
position the welding line parallel to carriage and turn the control levers or push buttons to align the electrode and the welding head over the weld joint for linear joints
adjust length of radial arm to position electrode over weld joint for radial joints
clamp cylindrical work pieces onto turning rolls under stationary head for circular joints
start the SAW machine for welding operations
adjust welding head to set specified angle of electrode

perform SAW process in all welding positions on specified materials and forms as per SOP and produce joints and components covering different joint configurations, specified quality, dimensions and profile
ensure correct work and travel angles, flow rate, travel speed, current, voltage, and slope, and synchronize feed of wire and electrode extensions as required for the job
adjust wire stick-out and machine setup to vary size, location, and penetration of bead
monitor the machine operations in accordance with specifications and job instructions
monitor the process operation and machine functions, and make adjustments as required to welding parameters and mechanisms within their permitted authority and tolerance
remove extra material, slag, spatter etc. by using brush, chipping hammers, hand scraper grinders etc., from the welded component
shut down the welding equipment and remove the component after completion of welding activities
check the welded component and ensure that it is meeting the required quality and dimensional accuracy within specified tolerances
identify various weld defects by conducting visual inspection, destructive and non-destructive tests on the work pieces
re-weld the defective joints, using manual welding equipment
store the weldments securely as per requirement by following organizational procedures
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
check the machine operations for any malfunctions/defects in the component and immediately inform the supervisor/maintenance team for correction
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
